en: The corridors are a maze, and a pilot waits round every bend. Skyla is at the very top, past them all.
Her Pokémon fly, so Electric, Ice and Rock moves will bring them down to earth.
Whoosh! Hold on to your hat in here. This Gym is a wind tunnel!
The propellers at the back are what make the gale. Here, have a drink to keep you going.
The pilots stand guard along the corridors, and Skyla waits on the stage. Flying Pokémon are weak to Electric, Ice and Rock moves!
You beat Skyla! That was a flight to remember.
Hee-hee! I've been waiting for you. You're a tough Trainer who can face the wind and not be blown off your feet!
I'm kind of excited about this battle! Shall we? You and me, wings spread!
You're an amazing Trainer. My Pokémon and I are happy: for the first time in a long while, we battled with everything we had!
Here, take this. It's the Jet Badge, proof that you beat me!
{player} received the Jet Badge from Skyla!
And I want you to have this TM, so that you'll always remember the Pokémon who flies the highest.
With a Badge from each of the winds, who knows how high you'll soar? I wonder what Professor Juniper is up to. I did promise her a ride in my plane...
Are you and your Pokémon well? Our battle was a ton of fun. My Pokémon want to train again just thinking about it.
Two things I love: flying my own plane, and having my Pokémon take me up using Fly!
